stemMd: Which pair of functional groups characterises a simple amino acid?

options.label: B
options.textMd: An amino group and a carboxyl group

options.label: D
options.textMd: A phosphate group and a steroid ring

explanationMd: Amino acids possess an amino group and a carboxyl group, commonly on the same central carbon in protein amino acids. Their side chains provide additional chemical differences.

distractorRationale.a: That does not supply the defining groups.
distractorRationale.e: These do not define amino acids.
distractorRationale.d: These belong to different structural categories.
distractorRationale.c: Ethers do not define an amino acid.
